question: India and France signed an implementation agreement on “MOBILISE YOUR CITY” (MYC) to reduce:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Green House Gas (GHG) emissions.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India and France signed an implementation agreement on the **“MOBILISE YOUR CITY” (MYC)** initiative primarily to reduce **Green House Gas (GHG) emissions**.
 
• The** MYC program aims** to help cities develop sustainable urban mobility plans that reduce carbon emissions
 
• It also promote cleaner, more efficient public transportation systems
 
• It supports three Indian cities (Nagpur, Kochi, and Ahmedabad) to reduce Green House Gas (GHG) emissions.
 
 
• It helps urban transport by implementing urban mobility plans at the local level and national level to improve their sustainable transport policy.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

__
 
• 21st Conference of Parties (COP21): Popularly known as the Paris Agreement.

 
 
• In 1992 United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC)
 
 
• and the 11th session of the Meeting of the Parties to the 1997 Kyoto Protocol (CMP 11).
 
 
 
• It aims to strengthen the global response to the threat of climate change by keeping a global temperature rise this century well below 2 degrees Celsius above pre-industrial levels and to pursue efforts to limit the temperature increase even further to 1.5 degrees Celsius.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The MYC agreement was signed by Mukund Kumar Sinha, OSD & Ex-Officio Joint Secretary in the Urban Affairs Ministry and the Regional Director of Agence Française de Développement (AfD), Nicolas Fornage.
